answer.evidence: RX power fell from ~-12.6 dBm to -40 dBm after 2026-10-21 12:00 with RX_LOS active; A-TX measures 0.6 dBm normal, B-ODF shows no light. OTDR from A at 1550 nm shows end at 25.713 km fibre distance and from B end at 20.86 km fibre distance, mapping to ~25.06 km route between SC-06 and SC-07, consistent with road works reported near km 27 on 2026-10-21 11:55.

Transmitter output 0.06 dBm normal. Power arriving at site B ODF -8.21 dBm gives link loss ~8.27 dB matching commissioning 8.34 dB. Receiver input -23.35 dBm is ~15.14 dB below B-ODF, far exceeding design 3 dB attenuator. Site notes show attenuator refitted from spares on 2026-10-22 02:59 UTC, immediately before RX power fell from ~-11.3 dBm to ~-23.3 dBm and BER rose. Embedded and 1550 nm OTDR show normal splice losses with no macrobend or break, and connectors are clean.

TX power dropped from ~+0.39 dBm to -2.72 dBm average, measured output -3.76 dBm. Link loss A-TX to B-ODF remains ~4.7 dB consistent with commissioning 4.8 dB. RX power low warning triggered by reduced launch power, not increased span loss. OTDR shows no excess loss or macrobend; connectors clean.

RX power degraded ~1.4 dB after site B ODF patching on 2026-10-18 23:33. Current power measurements show A-TX 1.65 dBm, B-ODF -3.33 dBm giving link loss 4.98 dB vs commissioning 3.67 dB. OTDR from B at 1550 nm shows reflective loss 1.71 dB at B-ODF connector (event 1 distance -0.001 km, reflectance -34.7 dB). Inspection of B-ODF end face shows contamination spots over core area. A-ODF inspection clean. TX power unchanged.

answer.evidence: Rx power dropped from ~-11.1 dBm to ~-13.4 dBm after patching work at MID-PP on 2026-10-22 15:41. Power measurements show A-TX 1.44 dBm and B-ODF -8.25 dBm, giving ~9.7 dB fibre loss versus 7.5 dB commissioning. OTDR at 1550 nm from A shows a 2.56 dB reflective event at 15.317 km fibre distance, mapped to route km 14.964 at element MID-PP. Embedded OTDR also shows 2.6 dB reflective loss at the same location. Inspection of MID-PP reveals a scratch/damage across the core, while A-ODF and B-ODF appear clean. The high reflectance (~-24 dB) and ~2.5 dB loss are consistent with a damaged connector introduced during the 22 Oct patching.

1550 nm OTDR from site A shows a 2.1 dB non-reflective loss at 16.306 km fibre distance, mapped to route km ~15.99 between splice closures SC-03 and SC-04. Optical power measurements show A-TX 1.69 dBm and B-ODF -6.7 dBm, giving a fibre loss of 8.39 dB versus commissioning 6.21 dB, an increase of ~2.18 dB consistent with the OTDR step. Receiver power dropped from ~-11.6 dBm to ~-13.7 dBm from 2026-10-23, matching the timing of the loss event.

Link loss increased from commissioning 10.15 dB to measured 11.83 dB (A-TX 1.52 dBm, B-ODF -10.31 dBm). OTDR 1550 nm from A shows non-reflective loss 1.7 dB at fibre km 5.188, mapped to SC-01 route km 5.078. Site notes show SC-01 re-entered 2026-10-24 22:07 UTC, just before RX_LOW_WARNING at 23:00 UTC on 2026-10-24. TX power unchanged, attenuator loss normal, connectors clean.
